findings.title: Exact implementation dependency versions are intentionally deferred
findings.evidence: R3 remains design-only and U01 reserves a single exact version decision for authorized GATE_0.
findings.risk: Skipping the later decision could select incompatible versions.
findings.disposition: retain; do not run an unauthorized download or compatibility spike

findings.title: Heritage was source-reopened but is not yet a J02-specific frozen registry asset
findings.evidence: Dexter selection cites exact D01-S05/commercial-group-root paths; the inherited registry freezes only its R1 denominator.
findings.risk: Future ad-hoc rereads could become less reproducible if Heritage changes.
findings.disposition: ask Claude whether a minimal v2s-native hash receipt is sufficient before implementation; do not copy or mutate Heritage in this design cycle

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: The revised design still solves the accepted explicit-initialization task rather than an interface-led lookup.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: Reverse workspace query, duplicated facts and a separate initialization page were rejected as owner, data or UI regressions.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: The added typed grant, composite FK and precise ownership are bounded protections required by existing architecture rules, not new features.

conclusion.summary: All M/S findings from the fresh independent review are resolved with source-backed minimal changes; two non-blocking future gates remain explicitly bounded.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: This is a final DESIGN-cycle decision only. It does not grant GATE_0, implementation, runtime, database, seed/reset or Git authority.
